provenance.method: Independent native curve-point oracle, rational spans, whole-plane-word Boolean equations and ordered border pixels; no SyncTERM output or Atari execution.
provenance.native_initial: primary0x5aa5 XOR plane*0x1357, alternate0xa55a XOR plane*0x2468
provenance.native_foreground: Effective logical fill pen7 retained across modes, physical5 masked to active depth
provenance.application_foreground: Wire C2,7 selects physical5 in low mode and logical1/active mask in medium/mono. Recolour zero-background runs to that independent pen result; XOR uses active mask.
provenance.safe_domain: Signed-radius native predicates on non-wrapping inputs; host writes discarded after native border traversal. Wide overflow corrections and extreme words have separate literal tests.
